name: westland
description: Westland organizational plugin — safety hooks, house-style references, and bug-report capture. Install first; required dependency of domain plugins (scheduling, estimating, etc.). Contains the Westland Project Files PreToolUse hook (modify-prompt on existing files; .xer in-place changes and deletes denied — move to _Archive; .html / .md / .json allowlisted as freely-editable working artifacts), the westland-house-style skill, and the westland-bug-report skill (Procore-OAuth-gated bug capture to Supabase via the westland-feedback MCP).
